articles.summary: A peer-reviewed 2026 study at two US universities had 170 computing students watch AI-generated instructional videos made with Knowlify. Students rated the videos 4.52 out of 5 for production quality and scored 86% on a knowledge test, half could not tell the videos were AI-generated, and 68% still preferred videos recorded by their instructor.
articles.title: What 170 Students Think of AI-Generated Instructional Videos (2026 Study)

articles.summary: The best Synthesia alternatives in 2026 include Knowlify for document-to-video and animated explainers, HeyGen for avatar realism and translation, Colossyan for L&D, and D-ID for low-cost photo avatars. Ten options compared on price, format, and document support.
articles.title: The 10 Best Synthesia Alternatives in 2026 (Tested & Compared)
